[
  {
    "source_locator": "web_paragraph_0008",
    "excerpt_original": "Contrary to the conventional wisdom of high-fidelity simulation, DARPA experts theorize that learning and transferring autonomy across diverse, low-fidelity simulations leveraging their shared semantics (e.g., rules of engagement) instead can lead to a more rapid transfer of autonomy from simulation to reality – perhaps even as early as the same-day versus weeks/months with traditional approaches.",
    "excerpt_zh": "与高保真模拟的传统观点相反，DARPA专家推测，利用共享语义（如交战规则）在多样化的低保真模拟中学习和迁移自主性，可以更快地将自主性从模拟迁移到现实——甚至可能当天完成，而传统方法需要数周或数月。",
    "normalized_claim": "DARPA专家推测，利用低保真模拟的共享语义进行自主性迁移，可能实现当天从模拟到现实的迁移，而传统方法需要数周或数月。",
    "evidence_nature": "goal",
    "coding_dimensions": [
      "application_maturity",
      "engineering_resource_conditions"
    ],
    "topics": [
      "sim-to-real transfer",
      "low-fidelity simulation",
      "autonomy learning"
    ],
    "possible_corroboration_group": "DARPA TIAMAT program theory"
  },
  {
    "source_locator": "web_paragraph_0009",
    "excerpt_original": "The Transfer from Imprecise and Abstract Models to Autonomous Technologies program seeks proposals that put this theory to the test.",
    "excerpt_zh": "“从不精确和抽象模型向自主技术迁移”项目寻求提案，以检验这一理论。",
    "normalized_claim": "DARPA的TIAMAT项目正在寻求提案，以检验低保真模拟迁移自主性的理论。",
    "evidence_nature": "goal",
    "coding_dimensions": [
      "application_maturity"
    ],
    "topics": [
      "DARPA program",
      "autonomy transfer",
      "proposal solicitation"
    ],
    "possible_corroboration_group": "DARPA TIAMAT program"
  },
  {
    "source_locator": "web_paragraph_0013",
    "excerpt_original": "The program will feature sim-to-sim and sim-to-real competitions at the end of Phases 1 and 2, respectively, with the results of the first competition being used to down-select from six performers to three.",
    "excerpt_zh": "该项目将在第一阶段和第二阶段结束时分别举办模拟到模拟和模拟到现实的竞赛，第一次竞赛的结果将用于从六家执行者中筛选出三家。",
    "normalized_claim": "TIAMAT项目将在第一阶段和第二阶段结束时分别举办模拟到模拟和模拟到现实的竞赛，第一次竞赛结果用于从六家执行者中筛选出三家。",
    "evidence_nature": "test_event",
    "coding_dimensions": [
      "application_maturity",
      "trust_governance_constraints"
    ],
    "topics": [
      "competition",
      "sim-to-sim",
      "sim-to-real",
      "down-selection"
    ],
    "possible_corroboration_group": "DARPA TIAMAT program competitions"
  },
  {
    "source_locator": "web_paragraph_0014",
    "excerpt_original": "The program is organized into two phases. Phase 1 is 18 months and will develop sim-to-sim autonomy transfer techniques and novel methods for automatically developing or refining low-fidelity models and simulations to be used for transfer. Phase 2 is 18 months and will develop sim-to-real autonomy transfer techniques and novel methods for automatically developing or refining low-fidelity models and simulations to be used for transfer.",
    "excerpt_zh": "该项目分为两个阶段。第一阶段为期18个月，将开发模拟到模拟的自主性迁移技术，以及自动开发或改进用于迁移的低保真模型和模拟的新方法。第二阶段为期18个月，将开发模拟到现实的自主性迁移技术，以及自动开发或改进用于迁移的低保真模型和模拟的新方法。",
    "normalized_claim": "TIAMAT项目分为两个18个月的阶段，分别开发模拟到模拟和模拟到现实的自主性迁移技术，以及自动开发或改进低保真模型和模拟的方法。",
    "evidence_nature": "goal",
    "coding_dimensions": [
      "application_maturity",
      "engineering_resource_conditions"
    ],
    "topics": [
      "program structure",
      "sim-to-sim",
      "sim-to-real",
      "low-fidelity models"
    ],
    "possible_corroboration_group": "DARPA TIAMAT program"
  },
  {
    "source_locator": "web_paragraph_0015",
    "excerpt_original": "Abstracts are due October 17, 2023, by noon ET. While abstracts are strongly encouraged, they are not required to submit a proposal. Proposals are due December 20, 2023, by noon ET.",
    "excerpt_zh": "摘要截止日期为2023年10月17日中午（东部时间）。虽然强烈鼓励提交摘要，但提交提案不要求必须提交摘要。提案截止日期为2023年12月20日中午（东部时间）。",
    "normalized_claim": "TIAMAT项目的摘要截止日期为2023年10月17日，提案截止日期为2023年12月20日。",
    "evidence_nature": "governance_event",
    "coding_dimensions": [
      "application_maturity"
    ],
    "topics": [
      "proposal deadline",
      "program solicitation"
    ],
    "possible_corroboration_group": "DARPA TIAMAT program solicitation"
  },
  {
    "source_locator": "web_paragraph_0006",
    "excerpt_original": "Training models in high-fidelity environments for Defense Department platforms can sometimes take months to even years. Furthermore, autonomy becomes vulnerable when faced with unknown situations/observations in the real world. This brittleness is known as the simulation-to-real (sim-to-real) gap.",
    "excerpt_zh": "为国防部平台在高保真环境中训练模型有时可能需要数月甚至数年。此外，当面对现实世界中的未知情况或观测时，自主性会变得脆弱。这种脆弱性被称为模拟到现实（sim-to-real）差距。",
    "normalized_claim": "为国防部平台在高保真环境中训练自主性模型可能需要数月甚至数年，且自主性在现实世界未知情况下脆弱，存在模拟到现实差距。",
    "evidence_nature": "constraint",
    "coding_dimensions": [
      "engineering_resource_conditions",
      "trust_governance_constraints"
    ],
    "topics": [
      "sim-to-real gap",
      "training time",
      "vulnerability"
    ],
    "possible_corroboration_group": "Sim-to-real gap challenges"
  }
]
